projects.subtitle: A selection of my best work across different domains

items.title: NovaMart E-Commerce
items.description: A high-performance e-commerce platform with real-time inventory, Stripe payments, and an AI recommendation engine serving 50k+ users.
items.fullDescription: NovaMart is a full-featured e-commerce solution built from the ground up with scalability in mind. It integrates Stripe for seamless payments, uses Redis for cart caching, and features a custom AI recommendation engine powered by collaborative filtering.
challenges: Optimising real-time inventory sync across multiple warehouses
Implementing fraud detection without adding checkout friction
Achieving sub-200ms page loads at 50k concurrent users
outcomes: Increased average order value by 32% via AI recommendations
Reduced cart abandonment rate from 70% to 48%

items.title: Taskly — Project Manager
items.description: A Notion-inspired project management tool with drag-and-drop boards, real-time collaboration, and smart task automation.
items.fullDescription: Taskly brings the best of Notion, Jira, and Linear into a single, fast, intuitive workspace. Real-time collaboration is powered by CRDTs over WebSockets, and task automation uses a custom rule engine.
challenges: Designing an intuitive drag-and-drop UX for nested task trees
Keeping WebSocket connections stable across unreliable networks
outcomes: Reached 5,000 MAUs within 3 months of launch
Teams reported 40% reduction in status-update meetings
Featured in Product Hunt's top 5 launches of the week

items.title: CodeLens — AI Code Review
items.description: An AI-powered code review tool that integrates with GitHub PRs to provide instant, context-aware feedback and security analysis.
items.fullDescription: CodeLens hooks into the GitHub API to review every pull request automatically. It uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect security vulnerabilities, style violations, and performance anti-patterns, providing inline comments directly on the diff.
challenges: Fine-tuning an LLM on proprietary code review datasets
Keeping review latency under 30 seconds for large diffs
Reducing false-positive rate from 25% to under 5%
outcomes: Adopted by 200+ engineering teams within 6 months
Reduced PR review cycle time by an average of 3 hours
Caught 1,200+ security issues before they reached production

items.title: WeatherFlow Dashboard
items.description: A beautiful weather dashboard with interactive maps, 10-day forecasts, and air quality data.
items.fullDescription: WeatherFlow visualises real-time and forecast weather data using interactive D3 charts, Mapbox maps, and smooth animations. Supports dark mode and offline caching via Service Workers.
challenges: Rendering smooth animated SVG wind direction vectors
Handling inconsistent data from multiple weather APIs

items.title: DevBlog CMS
items.description: A headless CMS for developers with MDX support, syntax highlighting, SEO automation, and a sleek admin dashboard.
items.fullDescription: DevBlog is a developer-first headless CMS with a rich MDX editor, auto-generated OG images, and built-in analytics. The admin dashboard provides real-time traffic stats and SEO scoring.
challenges: Building a performant MDX editor with live preview
Automating OG image generation without a headless browser
outcomes: Achieved 100/100 Lighthouse score on all posts

items.title: CryptoTrack Portfolio
items.description: A real-time crypto portfolio tracker with historical charts, price alerts, and tax reporting.
items.fullDescription: CryptoTrack connects to major exchanges via API to aggregate your holdings in real time. It generates tax reports in multiple jurisdictions and supports 500+ coins.
challenges: Real-time WebSocket price feeds from 8 exchanges simultaneously
Handling complex tax calculation rules across 30+ jurisdictions
outcomes: Saved users an average of 4 hours on tax reporting
